name.description: The heading of the top card

headline.description: The line under the name, as shown

location.description: The place beside the Contact info link, as shown

degree.description: What follows the name; self when it is the signed-in member's own profile; none when nothing shows

followers.description: The profile owner's follower count from the top card or the Activity section header, e.g. 2,850 followers as 2850; check Activity when absent from the top card, and return null only when neither location shows a count

company.description: The first of the buttons with a logo under the headline, when there is one

school.description: The second of those buttons, when there is one

url.description: The profile's address, https://www.linkedin.com/in/<slug>/, from the Contact info link without its /overlay/contact-info/
